name: Jina AI
description: Search foundation APIs (embeddings, reranking, Reader) with free tokens on every key.
overview: Jina AI's search foundation APIs cover embeddings, rerankers and the Reader URL-to-markdown service. Every new visitor gets an auto-generated API key with free tokens usable on any Jina model. These are embedding, rerank and reader models rather than chat LLMs.
free_access: Free tokens on an auto-generated key
notes: Embeddings, rerank and Reader only, not chat completion.
